iterationPolicy: Demo, review and retro before any next iteration. Loop repetition is for WIP motion review, not a mathematical C1 or finished-contact certification.
scope: Bounded right forefoot contact correction on the same49-key Jog v5 loop. Frozen arms, seam neighborhood, Walk/Face, geometry, targets and appearance; no slowdown, crossfade or new basis.

comparisonCamera.scope: Shared whole-character source-world comparison camera. The exact same QA stride restoration and native ground apply before/after; production initial camera and in-place root are unchanged.

diagnosticContact.groundDefinition: Native right-sole support floor in Blender Z-up, mapped to runtime Y-up. Not an invented visual floor.
diagnosticContact.rootTravelFraction: native key / 48; source498 is zero. Unwrapped seam keys accumulate the same QA stride continuously.
diagnosticContact.rootTravelConvention: Production Jog stays in-place. Only paused diagnostic contact samples restore the identical removed v5 linear stride through a QA parent group; seam neighbors accumulate this exact stride. No production root changes.
diagnosticContact.soleMappingScope: Seven verified persistent sole surface vertices; corner duplicates share exact skin and position-morph data. Public labels are generic, not source vertex IDs.

limitations: Contact correction is bounded to native520–543; exact v5 seam neighborhood and upper-body style are retained.
Contact improvement is not a smoothness guarantee. Native knee derivatives and actual browser release views remain part of the review.
Existing fixed-basis deformation limitations remain; no new targets were added. Inherited v5 residuals are historical, not a new v6 fit measurement.
Endpoint equality does not imply mathematically C1 LINEAR runtime animation. Actual repetition is for WIP review, not finished-motion certification.

loopValidation.interpretation: Approval to repeat the bounded contact candidate for WIP review. Exact seam preservation; not mathematical C1, no-slide or artistic acceptance.

provenance.scope: Declared contact-only animation edits on exact frozen v5 model; no new geometry or basis.

diagnosticBefore.policy: Exact v5 loop data sampled diagnostically at the same native keys. Production v5 behavior remains unchanged on its existing route.
